{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Sub-surface Displacement Missile''' is the hardpoint used for [[Sub-surface Mining|sub-surface mining]]. It extracts internal asteroid deposits after a [[Prospector Limpet Controller|prospector limpet]] has identified a suitable deposit.

{{Draft warning}}

== Mining role ==

{{#invoke:Mining|equipmentNote|page=Sub-surface Displacement Missile}}

In practice, the commander targets a scanned sub-surface deposit, fires the missile, holds it while the deposit indicator moves, and releases it during the highlighted extraction band. The released chunks still need to be collected and refined.

== Fit notes ==

A displacement missile launcher is not enough by itself. A useful sub-surface setup also needs a prospector controller, collector support, a refinery, cargo space, and limpets.
